name: No Rest for the Wicked
body:
School transmutation; Level paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, DF

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target 1 creature/level
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort partial; see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target of this spell is exhausted. A creature with fewer Hit Dice than the paladin’s caster level that successfully saves is fatigued instead.

This spell has no effect on good-aligned creatures.
